world_environment: all geom_bodyid == 0, independent of contype/conaffinity; exactly one world endpoint
normal_aggregation: math.fsum(max(0, fn)) over ALL world↔robot points BEFORE threshold
air_duration: contiguous tick count * physics_dt; no per-contact cutoff
landing_contacts: every positive world↔robot point, including sub-1N; original ci and both geom/body identities
contact_force_world: force on geom2 = ct.frame.reshape(3,3).T @ local_force[:3]; robot geom1 negates
nonfinite: explicit latched instrumentation error, last good streamed prefix retained; never zero fill
private_diagnostic: force sum + actual model body-mass sum + optional existing cached pre-stage root rotation/subtreeCOM; not complete trueCOMproper
